Low thinking kept turns 1-4 short (124-2320 thinking chars, 94-745 tokens), but turn 5, one response writing six files, generated 16915 tokens (47683 thinking chars) at 1.77 tok/s: 9550 s, 88% of the session in one generation (see AGENT-THINKING-RUNAWAY-01, now bounded at 18 min per turn). The user settings still hold modelThinkingPreferences {"qwen3.8:27b": "low"} and maxToolCallSteps 50 (backup of the earlier settings in %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\audit\settings.backup-20260926.json); the next live needs the user's choice of configuration (thinking low, thinking off, or qwen3-coder:30b for the advice wording only).

[P2] AGENT-THINKING-RUNAWAY-01: Code complete on 2026-09-27, live confirmation pending. In qwen3.8 thinklow-20260926g (2026-09-26) one turn with think "low" reasoned for 9550 s (47683 thinking chars, 16915 tokens) before six write_file calls. An agent turn may now reason for a tenth of the session timeout (reasoningBudgetMs, 5-30 min; 18 min for the live 180-minute sessions) before its first content or tool call: agentStreamTransport closes the request (REASONING_BUDGET_ERROR), the cut reasoning stays out of the transcript and the model gets feedback asking for the next step with brief reasoning; a second cut in the same turn ends the run on transport_budget. The silent tool-call generation after the reasoning does not count. Verified: transport tests (cut and closed request; silent tool call past the budget accepted), orchestrator retry test, test:fast, test:e2e:electron. Remaining: a live run with a thinking model that reaches the budget (the next qwen3.8 run, see QWEN38-FULLTASK-01). No live run on 2026-09-27, by user choice.
